::: {.about-header}
## Poulami Sarker
PhD Student, Public Policy & Political Economy  
The University of Texas at Dallas
:::

::: {.about-section}
### Research interests
My research focuses on the political economy of health, health policy, and applied policy evaluation. I am particularly interested in how institutional design and policy changes shape behavior and outcomes, using quantitative and quasi-experimental approaches.
:::

::: {.about-grid}
::: {.about-card}
### Current research themes
- Political economy of health and health systems  
- Policy evaluation and causal inference  
- Labor and productivity policy questions  
:::

::: {.about-card}
### Methods and tools
- Methods: Regression, Causal inference, Quasi-experimental designs  
- Tools: R, Quarto, Stata  
- Outputs: Reproducible reports, Web publishing, Data visualization  
:::
:::
